_meta.description: Demo knowledge base of BIS certification and compliance rules for BIS Sahayak AI prototype.
_meta.disclaimer: This is synthetic demo data created for hackathon prototyping. Certification categories, product lists, and process details are illustrative. The official list of products under compulsory certification is notified by the Government of India. Always verify at https://www.bis.gov.in.

certification_rules.title: Electronics and IT Products — Compulsory Registration
certification_rules.description: Certain electronics and IT products must be registered with BIS before sale or import into India. The product must bear the BIS standard mark (IS logo with R-number). This requirement is notified under the Electronics and Information Technology Goods Order.
compliance_requirements: Product testing from BIS-recognised laboratory
Online registration via BIS CRS portal
Standard mark (IS logo + R-number) on product and packaging
Registration renewal as per BIS schedule
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Products not registered may be seized or prohibited from sale under applicable government orders.

certification_rules.title: Cement — Compulsory BIS Certification
certification_rules.description: Cement (all types and grades) is covered under compulsory BIS certification. Manufacturers must obtain an ISI mark license from BIS before cement can be sold in the Indian market.
compliance_requirements: BIS license under Scheme I for the relevant IS code
Factory inspection and production unit approval
Regular testing of cement samples at BIS-approved labs
ISI mark on cement bags with license number
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Manufacturing or selling cement without BIS certification is an offence under the BIS Act, 1986.

certification_rules.title: Steel Products — BIS Certification
certification_rules.description: Certain steel products, including bars for concrete reinforcement and structural steel, are covered under compulsory BIS certification.
compliance_requirements: BIS license for the applicable steel IS code
Chemical composition and mechanical property testing
Regular factory audits by BIS
ISI mark on products or tags
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Sale of uncertified steel products is subject to BIS Act provisions.

certification_rules.title: Household Electrical Appliances — Safety Standards
certification_rules.description: Household electrical appliances must comply with safety standards as specified in the IS 302 series. Products under compulsory certification must bear the ISI mark.
compliance_requirements: Testing per IS 302 safety standards
BIS license under Scheme I
Periodic factory and product inspections
ISI marking on product and packaging
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Products found non-compliant may be recalled and manufacturer subject to BIS Act penalties.

certification_rules.title: Solar Water Heating Systems — BIS Certification
certification_rules.description: Solar water heating systems are covered under compulsory BIS certification. Both flat-plate and evacuated tube collector systems must conform to applicable IS codes.
applicable_products: Flat plate collector solar water heaters
Evacuated tube collector solar water heaters
compliance_requirements: Performance testing per IS 14680 and related standards
BIS license for solar water heating systems
Thermal performance and durability testing
ISI mark on systems and components
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-certified solar water heating systems cannot be sold as BIS-certified products.

certification_rules.title: Food Products — BIS Standards
certification_rules.description: BIS has developed standards for various food products, though mandatory certification may be limited. Voluntary BIS certification signals quality assurance to consumers.
compliance_requirements: Product testing at BIS-recognised labs
Voluntary or compulsory certification as notified
Labeling compliance with IS code reference
Periodic renewal and surveillance
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance with notified food product standards may attract FSSAI and BIS enforcement actions.

certification_rules.title: Automotive Components — BIS Certification
certification_rules.description: Certain automotive components and accessories are covered under BIS certification. Compliance ensures safety and interoperability in the Indian automotive market.
compliance_requirements: Testing per relevant automotive IS codes
BIS license for covered automotive products
Factory and product inspections
ISI marking on automotive components
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Uncertified automotive components are subject to seizure and BIS enforcement.

certification_rules.title: Toys — Safety Certification
certification_rules.description: Toys sold in India must comply with safety requirements as per IS 9873 series. BIS has introduced compulsory registration for certain toy categories.
compliance_requirements: Safety testing per IS 9873 series
BIS registration for notified toy categories
Age grading and warning labels
Compliance with small parts and sharp edge requirements
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliant toys may be prohibited from sale under consumer protection and BIS regulations.

certification_rules.title: Textiles and Apparel — BIS Standards
certification_rules.description: BIS has developed numerous standards for textiles and apparel, covering fiber composition, colorfastness, dimensional stability, and safety requirements.
compliance_requirements: Testing per relevant textile IS codes
Voluntary BIS certification available
Labeling with fiber composition and IS code reference
Quality assurance per BIS standards
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Mislabeling of fiber composition may attract Consumer Protection Act provisions.

certification_rules.title: Medical Devices — BIS Certification
certification_rules.description: Certain medical devices and equipment are covered under BIS standards. Compliance with IS codes ensures safety and performance of medical devices used in Indian healthcare.
compliance_requirements: Testing per relevant medical device IS codes
BIS or CDSCO certification as applicable
Biocompatibility and safety testing
Labeling and traceability requirements
certification_rules.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliant medical devices may be restricted from sale under health and safety regulations.
